notes.subject: חסיד/תתחסד · תמים/תתמם
notes.rationale: Each half mirrors root-for-root: the adjective returns as the verb — hesed-tigi/hesed, tilennen/wulilen-tiya; the paronomasia is kept by hyphenation.

notes.subject: גבור
notes.gloss-note: here 'one who rises upright' rather than the usual 'warrior' — parallel to תמים; some read 'hero, blameless one'.

notes.subject: גבור
notes.rationale: Common rendering is 'upright man/hero'; the root גבר means strength — 'the strong one of integrity' also fits.

translation: Ni hesed-tigi ye, i bɛ ye hesed kɛ; ni kanuya-tigi ye min bɛ ka wuli tilennen na, i bɛ ye wulilen-tiya ye.
